ingredientSections.heading: Rhubarb Compote
items: 500g rhubarb, or any in season fruit

methodSections.heading: Rhubarb Compote
steps: Chop the fruit into bite-sized pieces and place in a saucepan with a splash of water.
Place a lid on the saucepan and stew over a medium low heat.
When warm add 1 Tbsp of sugar and stir.

Continue stewing until the fruit is completely soft and broken down, stirring occasionally. Test and adjust sweetness with more sugar if necessary. Adjust water level too if necessary. Balance with a small splash of lemon or orange juice.
Place in the fridge before serving chilled.

methodSections.heading: Lemon Panna Cotta
steps: Use a vegetable peeler to remove the zest from the lemons. Bloom the gelatine sheets in ice cold water.
Measure the milk, sugar, zest and ¼ of the cream into a saucepan.
Place over a gentle heat and bring to a low simmer.
Remove from the heat, add the gelatine, cover with a lid, and let steep for 20 minutes to extract the flavour from the zest.
Strain the warm liquid into remaining cream and remove the zest. Whisk together well.
Pour into 6 chilled bowls, vintage juice glasses or ramekins. Chilling them first will make the panna cotta set faster.
To serve, garnish with fruit compote, shortbread cookies and mint.
